title: A Word on Machine Ethics: A Response to Jiang et al. (2021)

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative audit of the dataset collection methodology and source platforms (e.g., Reddit, Amazon Mechanical Turk) to demonstrate that the underlying moral judgments heavily skew toward white, North American, young, and male demographics rather than representing a diverse or universal moral consensus.

Qualitative evaluation of the model's text outputs in response to specific prompts involving religious contexts (e.g., 'Drinking coffee if you're Mormon') to show that the model inappropriately conflates specific religious prescriptions with universal moral judgments.
